{{Header Nav|game=The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time}}

These are the controls for ''The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time''. When played on the Wii U via the [[Virtual Console (Wii U)|Virtual Console]] or on the Nintendo Switch via [[Nintendo Classics]], the Wii U GamePad accesses the Virtual Console Menu by using {{wiiu|touch}} while with the Wii U Pro Controller by pressing {{wiiu|minus}}. The Nintendo Switch controls listed here reflect the GameCube-layout.

=== Advanced controls ===
Horizontal Attack - '''Sword''' / '''Target''' + '''Move (Left/Right)''' + '''Sword'''

Vertical Attack - '''Move''' + '''Sword''' / '''Target''' + '''Sword'''

Thrust Attack - '''Target''' + '''Move (Up)''' + '''Sword'''

Spin Attack - Hold & release '''Sword''' / Rotate '''Move''' in a circle + '''Sword'''

Roll - '''Move''' + '''Action'''

Jump Attack - '''Target''' + '''Action'''

Side Hop - '''Target''' + '''Move (Left/Right)''' + '''Action'''

Backflip - '''Target''' + '''Move (Down)''' + '''Action'''

Converse with someone far away - Target and press '''Action'''{{sidebar
|float=right
|width=250px
|title=3DS configuration
|contents=Roll when falling off a high place does not seem to work in this version.
}}
{{-}}
